title: Digital Marketing Executive
description:
Job Title: Digital Marketing Executive Company: Kainskep Solutions
 Location: Jaipur, Rajasthan
 Experience: 2-4 Years Job Summary Kainskep Solutions is looking for a results-driven Digital Marketing Executive to manage digital campaigns, generate quality leads, improve online visibility, and support the company's marketing objectives. Key Responsibilities Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and LinkedIn Ads. Manage SEO activities, keyword research, website optimization, and organic traffic growth. Develop and execute social media marketing strategies. Generate and nurture leads through digital channels. Monitor campaign performance, analyze data, and optimize campaigns for better ROI. Track marketing KPIs using Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager (GTM), and other analytics tools. Coordinate with the content and design teams for marketing creatives, landing pages, and promotional content. Prepare regular campaign performance reports and recommend improvements. Stay updated with digital marketing trends, tools, and best practices. Required Skills 24 years of hands-on digital marketing experience. Practical experience with Google Ads and Meta Ads. Knowledge of SEO, SEM, social media marketing, and lead generation. Familiarity with GA4, GTM, keyword research, and campaign analytics. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills. Experience in B2B or IT services marketing will be an advantage. Preferred Candidate A self-driven professional who can manage campaigns independently. Someone who understands performance marketing, lead generation, and conversion optimization. Candidates based in Jaipur are preferred.

Key Skills: Social media marketing,Lead generation,Facebook,Linkedin Ads,Advertising,AdWords,Media marketing,Marketing
